response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_executions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM orderexecutions), with_shares AS (SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.exec_count, CAST(ec.exec_count AS FLOAT) / te.total_count as share, AVG(CAST(ec.exec_count AS FLOAT) / te.total_count) OVER () as avg_share FROM execution_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_executions te), with_difference AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - avg_share as diff FROM with_shares) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, diff FROM with_difference ORDER BY diff DESC, ordersmark IS NULL ASC LIMIT 10
